description: In kits.json the day count for both postoperative eGFR measurements (first_postop_egfr and last_postop_egfr) is named days_before_nephrectomy. The data paper specifies this subfield as "days after nephrectomy" for postoperative values. The field name contradicts its documented meaning.
inspectedScope: All 210 case records in data/kits.json at commit 67e495d, compared field by field with section 3 of the data paper.

evidence.note: Cases with a non-null postoperative day count.

detection: Comparison of the released field names with the specification in the data paper.
impact: Code or readers going by the field name would treat postoperative measurement times as preoperative, which reverses the timing of renal-function outcomes.
handling: Read these two fields as days after nephrectomy, as the paper defines them. KiTS23's kits23.json names the same fields days_after_nephrectomy.

description: Several values in kits.json are stored differently from the data paper's specification. age_when_quit_smoking is specified as an integer but stored as text (for example "43"); pack_years mixes integers (every integer is 0) with numbers written as text (for example "30"). Categorical values also differ in form: underscores replace spaces ("clear_cell_rcc" for "clear cell rcc"), surgical_approach is capitalized and vital_status is lowercase where the paper shows the opposite, and chewing_tobacco_use uses "never_or_not_in_last_3mo" where the paper lists "never or not for more than 3mo".
inspectedScope: All 210 case records in data/kits.json at commit 67e495d, compared field by field with section 3 of the data paper.

evidence.note: Cases where age_when_quit_smoking or pack_years holds a number stored as text (54 and 43 cases). The categorical formatting differences apply to every case.

detection: Profiling value types and distinct values for every field, compared with the paper.
impact: Numeric analyses that do not convert text values will drop or mis-sort these cases, and value matching against the paper's lists will fail.
handling: Convert numeric text to numbers, keeping "not_applicable" and null distinct, and match categorical values on the forms that occur in the file (listed in this release's data dictionary).
